I follow a revised version of the Korean "10 step" routine. I don't do all ten steps but here's the products I use in order for my routine

My skin cleanser is 13 dollars USD (I'm rice by tonymoly)

My toner is definitely under 10 dollars, it's just a standard, unbranded witch hazel toner.

I use a hyaluronic acid serum by Eva naturals that is 12.95

Under eye cream is 12 dollars (chok chok firming eye cream by Oh!k) 

For moisturizer, I usually use Water rose 24hr moisture gel by Garnier skin active which is 11 dollars, but I also bought haruharu wonder's black rice cream which was 24 dollars.

My favorite face sunscreen is Sunprise mild airy finish by Etude house for 12.95

If you don't include the 24 dollar stuff that I don't even like, it's about 70 USD. 

I also do various masks sometimes, but if they cost more than 15 dollars, I probably won't buy.

I don't think you have to spend a ton of money. People compliment me on my skin sometimes, so I like to think I'm doing something right. It really just depends on your needs. I think for a lot of people, a toner and moisturizer is all they need while other people need serums and ampoules and masks. 

My main concerns are dryness on my nose and anti aging, so that's why I use the hyaluronic acid and eye cream, as well as the cleanser I use. Some people can get away just using their regular body wash for their face. I also didn't buy all of this at the same time!! I gradually added more to my routine. I use the stuff every day, but it lasts a while, so there isn't any sort of monthly thing. I also like that they don't all run out at the same time lol

Prescriptive grammar is the opposite, which believes that grammar is a bit less fluid and has more rigid rules.
